pages.text: $(li)Prefer long intervals ($(5)EVERY 8 SECONDS$(), or $(5)EVERY 60 SECONDS$() for slow processes) over $(5)EVERY 20 TICKS$() or faster. The cost comes when items actually move, not from checking.

$(li)Put related actions in one $(5)EVERY … DO … END$() block instead of many blocks firing at once; stagger the rest with offsets.$(li)Target exact slots ($(5)SLOT 0$()) instead of ranges or sides to skip slots that can't be extracted, and name exact items instead of wildcards or bare $(5)INPUT$().
$(li)$(5)RETAIN$() costs next to nothing and helps SFM size its transfers.

$(li)Frequent full-stack inputs can overwhelm slow machines; feed smaller amounts more often.$(li)Code running more often than every 20 ticks: use $(5)EVERY REDSTONE PULSE DO$() with a redstone clock, or copy the code into $(5)EVERY 20+1 TICKS DO$(), $(5)EVERY 20+2 TICKS DO$() and so on.
